sources.label: Morphe Patches To Remove Ads From Facebook Lite
sources.author: Morphe FB Lite
patch_list: Opens links in the phone's default browser instead of Facebook Lite's built-in browser.
Hides sponsored posts in the news feed and removes sponsored reels as they load.
Lets the patched app install while Facebook, Messenger or other Meta apps are installed, by renaming the permissions it shares with them.
Adds a settings screen to the app icon's long-press menu, with a font size slider.
Blocks the downloaded Meta fonts (Optimistic, Instagram Sans, emoji, ...) so the app falls back to the system font.
Draws feed text with the system font instead of the font the server sends.
Video download and auto next reel
Adds a button to download the playing video in HD or SD (you choose the quality), and moves to the next reel when one ends. These are switched in the Morphe settings screen.
